decisions.ambiguity: JDBC driver for tests vs no new dependencies
decisions.decision: Main dependencies stay unchanged (CON-BUILD-006). A test-only org.xerial sqlite-jdbc testImplementation on NaruServe-api is allowed, following the existing test-only precedent (Jetty for NaruServe-servlet tests, build.gradle:362-369). MySQL/PostgreSQL steps are verified by SQL text/fake-JDBC tests and recorded as a verification limit (00 §12).
Out of 0.11.0 (not in the v1 roadmap row); keep only the Kotlin compile/run test of the new public API (CLAUDE.md T11, FR-KT-*).

Five new scopes: AUTH (core/pipeline/docs/build), TOKEN (tokens, keys, passwords, MiniJson, refresh store), FLOW (transport, CSRF, endpoints, abuse protection), IAM (users, groups, roles, grants, JDBC user/group/refresh/throttle/device stores), APIKEY (API keys, service accounts, JdbcApiKeyStore). Core changes stay in APP (C4), HTTP (C6a, C7), ENGINE (C6b).
decisions.basis: intent analyst proposal, GUARD merged into FLOW and JDBC split between IAM and APIKEY
